title: HesaValidationReportInboundV1
description: Inbound HESA validation report received from the HESA data collection portal and submitted via POST /api/v1/regulatory/hesa/returns/{returnId}/validation-reports. Contains blocking errors and warnings from HESA's validation engine against the submitted student return XML. Field names follow HESA Data Futures coding frame conventions.

HesaValidationReportPayload.description: Raw HESA validation report payload. The outer wrapper is a freeform record to accommodate HESA coding-frame-year variation; the known structure is documented in the properties below.

submissionReference.description: HESA submission reference assigned to the submitted return.

validatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when HESA completed validation.

errors.description: Blocking errors that prevent HESA acceptance. Must be resolved before the return can be accepted.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings. Should be reviewed; do not prevent acceptance.

studentIdentifiers.description: HESA student identifiers assigned or updated as part of this return. Only present in the acceptance report.

field.description: HESA field code (from the HESA coding frame) that failed validation, e.g. 'BIRTHDTE', 'FEEELIG'.

enrolmentId.description: SRS enrolment UUID of the affected student record, if identifiable.

hesaStudentId.description: HESA Student Identifier (HUSID) of the affected record, if assigned.

message.description: Human-readable description of the validation issue.

ruleCode.description: HESA rule code from the Data Futures business rules specification.

husid.description: HESA Unique Student Identifier assigned by HESA.

ownRef.description: Institution's own student reference as submitted.
